name: @waste/contracts
description: Shared wire primitives on zod 4: ids (UUIDv7), ISO dates, GeoJSON Position, Point and Polygon, cursor pagination, the health response, the permission vocabulary (from @waste/domain), the RFC 9457 problem body, GET /me, the half-open validity period, and the resources of two contexts with their write bodies and list queries: Organisation & Access (company, project, service provider, user with its derived status, role with its grants) and the Registry (waste fraction, container type, service frequency, product, customer, property with its parties, property group, shared collection point with its members, agreement, subscription, container, container service placement), Planning's (planning area with its boundary versions, collection calendar with its holidays, route scheme with its collection groups and their stop matching rules or picked containers, the occurrence preview) with the HH:MM time of day and the project's working week, and Resources' (vehicle type with its compatibility set, warehouse, depot, unloading station with its fractions, vehicle with its compartments, driver, the stock movement ledger and the asset state it folds onto with the five commands that append to it, the vehicle allocation with its commands and its events), and Execution's (the dated route with its progress and its two assignments, the dispatcher's commands over it, the pickup with its correction, the session, the proof of service holding the domain's shape table as a refine, the unload with its weights rule, the fourteen driver commands as a discriminated union with the batch, the outcome row and the receipt, and the outbox event). Consumed by apps/web and apps/api, and by packages/db for its types only. A context's module schemas land with its tables (build-order step 3 on). Ships TypeScript source for bundler and tsx consumers.
